name: livrea-workspace
description: Livrea's workspace: the engine (livrea), its command-line tool (@livrea/cli), its visual builder (@livrea/ui), its interactive playground (@livrea/playground) and its documentation site.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace livrea && npm run build --workspace @livrea/cli && npm run build --workspace @livrea/ui && npm run build --workspace @livrea/playground
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace livrea && npm run test --workspace @livrea/cli && npm run test --workspace @livrea/ui && npm run test --workspace @livrea/playground
